headline: Nigeria President Tinubu seeks Senate approval for $7.7 billion external borrowing
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu asked the Senate to approve N10.79 trillion in external borrowing, equivalent to roughly $7.7 billion, to fund part of the 2026 federal budget deficit.
why: Sovereign borrowing plans impact a nation's debt profile, foreign reserves, and domestic interest rate environments.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: The proposed external borrowing of N10.79 trillion will finance the federal budget deficit.
